title: Alleluia, for the Lord God Almighty reigns

lines.text: For the Lord God Almighty reigns
For the Lord God Almighty reigns
Worthy is the Lamb, worthy is the Lamb
Worthy is the Lamb, worthy is the Lamb

chords:
[Verse 1]
Alleluia, Alleluia, alleluia
For the Lord God Almighty reigns
Alleluia, Alleluia
For the Lord God Almighty reigns

[CHORUS]
Alleluia, holy, holy
You Lord God Almighty
Worthy is the Lamb, worthy is the Lamb
You are holy, holy
You Lord God Almighty
Worthy is the Lamb, worthy is the Lamb
Amen
